entry.title: Application by Australian Nursing and Midwifery Federation (145V) [2026] FWC 3010
entry.content:
The ANMF applied under s242 of the Fair Work Act for approval of a supported bargaining authorisation covering three aged care employers (Catholic Healthcare, Superior Care Group and Anglicare Southern Queensland). After weighing the s243 matters, Deputy President Butler found that the significant differences between the employers' operations and the lack of explanation for why only those three were included outweighed the factors favouring approval, and was not satisfied it was appropriate for them to bargain together.

Fair Work Commission, 19 Aug 2026, [2026] FWC 3010
